exposure: Implementation of a multilevel institutional program to reduce emergency peripartum hysterectomy
multilevel institutional program to reduce the rate of emergency peripartum hysterectomy
cohort: Women who delivered at a tertiary care regional obstetric hub in Milan between 2012 and 2020
finding: Implementation of a multilevel institutional program was associated with a reduction in emergency peripartum hysterectomy rates, alongside changes in cesarean section rates and PPH management practices.
mod_finding: A multilevel institutional program, which included reducing primary and repeated cesarean sections, led to a reduction in the rate of emergency peripartum hysterectomy.
